units.previous_finding: In the final exercise instruction, the Malayalam word order can be read as the last v in a return statement. Revise to clearly instruct using v in the last return statement; preserve the identifier and code.

The two translated code comments leave p dangling at the end (പോയിന്റർ വഴി i വായിക്കുക p and പോയിന്റർ വഴി i-യുടെ മൂല്യം മാറ്റുക p). Revise the comments to unambiguously say read i through pointer p and set i through pointer p, preserving the executable code.

The Malayalam phrase ആരംഭമൂല്യങ്ങൾ നൽകി in the make explanation suggests initial values were supplied for map entries. Clarify that make returns an initialized, usable but initially empty map, without implying that key-value pairs have been inserted.

In the interface-value explanation, Malayalam അടിസ്ഥാന കോൺക്രീറ്റ് ടൈപ്പ് for underlying concrete type can be confused with the distinct Go concept underlying type. Rephrase to unambiguously mean the concrete type stored inside the interface, consistent with the glossary; preserve the tuple and example code.

The emphasized empty interface term is written as the fused ശൂന്യഇന്റർഫേസ് instead of preferred glossary ശൂന്യ ഇന്റർഫേസ്. Restore natural term separation while preserving valid present emphasis and interface{} code.

The emphasized type assertion term is fused as ടൈപ്പ്അസർഷൻ, inconsistent with mandatory glossary ടൈപ്പ് അസർഷൻ. Make the visible term consistent and natural without changing protected inline code or present emphasis semantics.

The emphasized type switch term is fused as ടൈപ്പ്സ്വിച്ച്, inconsistent with mandatory glossary ടൈപ്പ് സ്വിച്ച്. Correct the visible term while preserving the present markup and protected switch example.

The Malayalam ലഭ്യമാക്കുക for fetch URLs can mean obtain or provide URL strings rather than fetch the web resources identified by URLs. Clarify that Crawl concurrently fetches the target pages/resources, avoids fetching the same URL twice, and caches URLs already fetched; preserve code and exercise scope.
